current_scope: Completed G1 session/handoff core fixes in stcontrol adapter, handoff endpoint, and user heartbeat production entry with bounded durability checkpoints and strict durable-session admission.

tests.details: Final P1 board: 44 tests passed, 0 failed

completed_work: Request admission now fails closed without a durable stcontrol envelope in managed and independent modes; request-path self-issued authority was removed.

Serialized tracker admission now rechecks durable session handle/mode/generation in-queue, promotes managed durable sessions only after out-of-queue ownership proof with in-queue generation revalidation, and rejects impossible DRAINING branches.
Managed activity accounting now uses bounded durability checkpoints so heartbeat/request updates stay mostly volatile but persist within the checkpoint window and on cleanup/tombstone boundaries.
Admin and user handoff now clear the opposite marker, retire prior managed sessions durably, and preserve mixed-cookie regression coverage.
R14 password version fencing, nonce fail-closed behavior, production heartbeat import, and admin-only telemetry suppression are covered by updated node tests.
